turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: 4 of the 11 customers who signed up in August 2026 (1-31 August) had at least one non-cancelled order between 1 August and 10 October 2026 (active customers by signup cohort, divided by signups); I have not turned that into a percentage, and there is no single metric for 'bought by a given date', since the signup-to-first-order rate only covers the first 30 days after signing up. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
